changelog: Added dedicated Ragdoll keybind (default key U) with movement cancellation and safety checks.
Major performance optimization: decoupled threads and reduced resmon to sub-0.03ms (idle 0.00ms-0.01ms).
Optimized ambient NPC behavior: eliminated pool allocations and table sorting, single-pass filtering.
Optimized population loops: cached PlayerId, removed non-per-frame natives from Wait(0), event-driven reapply.
